<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a template that forms a sulfonamide (N‑S bond) by breaking an S‑Cl bond, i.e., the forward reaction is the formation of a sulfonamide from an aromatic amine and phenylsulfonyl chloride.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl_chloride"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
